Support Group Saturday March 29th  
Topic:      New Recipes for Spring and Summer for Surgical Weight Loss Patients   Location:  Kenton County Public Library – Erlanger Branch 401 Kenton Lands Road Erlanger, KY    41018 Directions:  http://www.kentonlibrary.org/locations/erlanger Time:   11:00 – 12:00 Invitees: All Lap Band, gastric bypass, gastric sleeve (VSG), and medical weight loss patients! Are you bored with the same old recipes?  Come join Erin Ledonne RD LD to get some new Spring and Summer recipes!!   RSVP: erin@thebanddoctor.com
